title: InformationSystemService (catalogue instance schema)
description: Catalogue-instance projection of the metamodel InformationSystemService entity. The normative field set is defined by the metamodel schema; this file mirrors it and adds only the catalogue-instance layer (classification axes promoted to first-class fields by CR-IS-CAT-03B, governance, provenance, cross-catalogue references). Do not widen a normative enum here to accept a value the metamodel does not define: fix the record instead. A catalogue that diverges from the metamodel is a second source of truth.

id.description: OpenDEAM-local identifier. The metamodel pattern is the general ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z0-9-]+$; this catalogue narrows it to the ISS entity namespace so a record cannot be filed under another entity's identifier form.

lifecycle_status.description: CR-3R: lifecycle state from the metamodel lifecycle vocabulary.

service_kind.description: Classification axis 1 (CR-IS-CAT-03B): what kind of contract is offered. Promoted from the service-kind tag to a first-class field when the taxonomy was ratified. The tag remains as a mirror; the taxonomy gate asserts the two agree.

consumer_class.description: Classification axis 2 (CR-IS-CAT-03B): who consumes the service. Promoted from the consumer-class tag; the taxonomy gate asserts tag and field agree.

interaction_pattern.description: Classification axis 3 (CR-IS-CAT-03B): how the exchange is shaped, expressed at the contract level. Promoted from the interaction-pattern tag; the taxonomy gate asserts tag and field agree.

external_references.description: Identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEAM id (E004). Vendor systems appear here as corroboration evidence only (G-12); at least 3 distinct vendor systems are cited per record.

service_contract.description: Catalogue-instance layer. What the service exchanges, expressed as a contract rather than as an implementation.

offering.description: The capability, functionality or data the service makes available.

consumers.description: Consumer descriptions or canonical consumer ids.

contract_status.description: Classification axis 4 (contract maturity): how settled the contract is.

provided_by.description: Components or services that provide this service (dea:provides). Cross-catalogue targets resolve against vendored target-id snapshots.

exposed_via.description: Integration interfaces through which the contract is operationalised (dea:exposes). Owned by the II catalogue.

specializes.description: Core or profile specialisation (dea:specializes). For a platform service, dea:entity-platform-service per the D-3 conditional disposition.

governance.description: Catalogue-instance layer. Ownership and review state.
